title: Page 10
content_zh:
她先是微微颔首向他见了个礼，再转首看向四下。

「武道的代表还没来？」怎么没见到蓬莱的影子？

悠然自得品着茶的清罡真人，心底有数地答道。

「大概是还在路上磨蹭着不想见本道吧。」那小子见他一回就摆臭脸一回，这次要不是他家大师兄逼他来，恐怕那小子这辈子都不会再踏进极山道观一步。有礼数的叶慈，也不疾不徐地上前见礼。「见过真人。」清罡真人淡淡扫了他一眼。

「贵宫的神官大人，武艺进步相当神速呢。」年纪轻轻就贪快强行晋阶，她这主人是怎么教导他的？

「一心为主嘛，应该的。」清罡真人的话要有多酸，她的脸皮就有多厚。他冷冷笑道：「怕是短期内连续晋阶将会境界不稳，恐会有伤寿数。」她今日的笑意则是格外妩媚，「幸好我神宫什么不多，就是丹药多得有点过剩，他的那点小毛病，我早早就帮他给调理好了。」叶慈看着他俩在短暂的嘴上过招后，就半句话再也不说，只一运地互瞠起对方，他转身朝等在殿上的朔方他们摆摆手，要他们退出殿外去，省得若是出了什么事，到时恐会被波及。

来到殿外加入斐然他们的行列后，无事可做的众神捕，在尚善的怂恿下，开了几桌府将桌，一块儿打打牌消磨起时间。

半个时辰后，松岗跑去殿门处往里头一看，嗯……那两个正主还在激烈地目光交流中。

一个时辰后再去看……好吧，他们脸上都挂着阴阴的笑意，还笑得很愉快。

第9章(2)

一个半时辰后，姗姗来迟的蓬莱，总算是爬上极山道观来解救众生了。

乍见久违多年的故人，清罡真人很痛快地放弃再与野风暗地较劲，一改冷清不待见任何人的恶劣态度，朝蓬莱唤得很亲切。

「小、蓬、莱。」

蓬莱不慌不忙抖落一身的鸡皮疙痞，有板有眼地向他行礼致意。

「见过清罡真人。」死老道，都说过不要叫他那种名字了，年纪大就记性不好是不是？

「你家大师兄近来可好？」

「回真人，大师兄仍在闭关中。」

「怎么，那小子他还是成天想出家？」清罡真人没多久就再现出欠揍的原形，「说来你们黄金门也够有趣的，门下的弟子不是贪财就是恋权，不但有小偷，更有唯恐天下不大乱的，怎么你们上头就偏偏出了这么一个天天想遁入佛门的奇葩？」

「……」可以给他两刀吗？

「咳咳。」野风在蓬莱暗自磨牙霍霍时，不忘提醒这儿还有着她的存在。

「见过宫主。」地位不如人的蓬莱，再次弯下他的腰杆。

她也是一开口就让人想拿菜刀的那款，「我说蓬莱兄，虽然我是说过咱们的债务是两清了，但先前黄金门所积欠的利息，还有损坏我宫中建筑的赔偿费用，你能不能紧着些，早点派人把它给还」。「……」能给她三刀吗？

呜呜，大师兄有人欺负我……

仿佛已经看见蓬莱背后的丛丛怒焰，颇同情他的叶慈不忍地转过身，不忍看那两个都爱在嘴上损人的家伙虐待他。

「你近来的武艺进展到什么程度了？」清罡真人在他脸上的表情愈来愈不耐，大有下一刻就撂脸子走人之势时，及时扔出一个话题。

岂料蓬莱却是误会了，以为清罡真人这是嫌弃他的实力。

「真人若是嫌我没资格站在这儿，大可找个能替下我的。」他也不想来啊，可大师兄就是指名了他，他还能推出去不成？

清罡真人就算不看也知道蓬莱的实力在哪，只是见他说得那般自信，他忍不住屈指算算，然后他羟扯着薄盾露出嘲弄地一笑。

「原来是杀神转世。」

久违的字眼一入蓬莱的耳底，蓬莱原本墨色的眼珠即刻变得血红，叶慈见状连忙将野风拉进怀里，并往后退离了数步，唯有抖人家底细的清罡真人，没把蓬莱抑住，不断自身体里迸出的内劲给看在眼底。

顶着一殿狂昜的杀气，野风躲在叶慈的怀中向蓬莱提醒。

「收收你的杀意，我可不是大老远专程跑来这打架的。」要不要这么激动，才一句话就爆底，他家大师兄怎么放心把他放出来？

蓬莱强行压下眼底弥渴的杀意，握紧了双拳，试图平复下心跳和喘息，一旁作壁上观的清罡真人在野风赏了他一记白眼时，这才不情不愿地自袖中射出一张黄符贴在蓬莱的身上，满殿的杀气塞时消失得干干净净。

野风这下也设什么耐性与他们话什么家常，准备速战速决走人的她，在大殿上的气氛平定的差不多时，开口就直指重心。

「阅魂录的事，你们有何打算？」她今日会来这就是想解决十三年前的破事，和负起该有的责任，「既然阅魂录是自我宫中流出去的，那么我就有责任将它收回，以免它再在日后危害天下，就算收不回，我也要毁了它。」自从那回玄灵追杀倚谰失败，这一回，在大师兄的帮助下，黄金门的探子倒是查出了许多有关于阅魂录的秘闻，而大师兄之所以会派他来此，就是因这事的严重性并非只是他们三道就能承担得起的。

「魂纸祸乱天下，这事只能算是小的，重要的是，咱们不能让数百年前的祸首再复生。」

「祸首？」野风纳闷地扬起柳眉，但一旁没搭话的清罡真人，倒是不语地更进一盏茶。

「我师弟玄灵日前追查出，司徒霜所许出来的那两个魂役，虽是奉司徒霜为主，但他们却可能在世上另有其服侍的主人，且他们这些魂役，拥有能将魂主制成愧儡以保魂主不死，又不受魂主控制的能力。」野风当下刷白了脸色，能够脱离魂契的约束，并不受魂主控制的魂役？

那天下还不乱套了？

「真人？」蓬莱求教地看向在座活得最久，知晓世事也最多的清罡。

清罡真人搁下手中的茶盏，思忖了半晌后，他才启口。

「你们可知，阅魂录是打哪儿来的？又是由何人所制出？」

他俩齐齐揺首，「不清楚。」

谁会知道那玩意儿是由谁弄出来的？当年他们都还没出生好吗？

「本道只知，制出魂纸之人，当年所制出的第一批魂纸，材料用的就是他的子女，而在他离世之前，他恐怕也嘱咐他的传人，将他也给制成魂纸，借以转生万代。」

「什么！」

「因此你们要有空在道儿待箸，还不如赶紧下山去找出那位远在数百年前，就已放话想要转生的制纸者，不然下一回咱们将迎接的，就不是魂祸而已，而是魂难了。」

「合我等三方之势，再联合众国，难道还怕奈何不了他们？」蓬莱紧敛着眉心，很难接受日后将会有那种未来。

清罡真人一手撑着面颊，对他露出莫测高深的笑意。

「若本道说，有点难呢？」

【全书完】

跨年那天，我和暗夜还有仙仙三人在网路上跨年。

在等时间时，我们三个闲着无聊，就聊起了过年许愿这回事，然后聊着聊着，就开始歪楼，一路愈走愈远，直到……某痕：「如果世界末日到了，你们要囤啥？」某仙：「武器。」

病友：「粮食。」

某痕：「就设人想囤卫生纸吗？」

某仙：「……」

某病友：「……」

某痕：「我看过不少描写关于末世的小说，里头的男女主角们，在得知末世要来时，都嘛是食物囤呀囤、衣服堆呀堆，武器弄得跟军火商似的，只是在我眼中，他们就是一群屁股折不干;争的男女主」」聊天室现场有好一阵子寂静。

She first nodded slightly and saluted him, then turned her head and looked around.

"The martial arts representative hasn't come yet?" Why can't I see Penglai's shadow?

Qinggang Zhenren, who was sipping tea leisurely and contentedly, replied knowingly.

"Maybe he's still lingering on the road and doesn't want to see me." The kid put on a bad face every time he saw him. If his senior brother hadn't forced him to come here this time, I'm afraid that kid would never set foot in Jishan Taoist Temple again in his life.Ye Ci, who was polite, stepped forward to pay homage without haste."I've met the real person." Qinggang Zhenren glanced at him lightly.

"The priest of your palace has made rapid progress in martial arts." He was eager to advance through the ranks at a young age. How did her master teach him?

"You should be devoted to the Lord, that's what you should do." As harsh as Master Qinggang's words were, she was as thick-skinned as she was.He sneered and said: "I'm afraid that if you advance continuously in a short period of time, your realm will be unstable, and your life span may be damaged." Her smile today was particularly charming, "Fortunately, my palace doesn't have much, but there are too many pills. I helped him treat his little problem early.Okay." Ye Ci watched the two of them exchange words for a short time, then said nothing, and just stared at each other. He turned around and waved to Shuo Fang and the others who were waiting in the hall, asking them to leave the hall to avoid being affected if something happened.

After joining Fei Ran and the others outside the palace, the Gods, who had nothing to do, opened a few tables with Shang Shan and played cards together to kill time.

Half an hour later, Songgang ran to the palace door and looked inside. Well... the two principals were still making intense eye contact.

I went to see them after an hour... Well, they all had sinister smiles on their faces, and they were smiling happily.

Chapter 9(2)

An hour and a half later, Penglai, who arrived belatedly, finally climbed up to the Taoist Temple on Jishan Mountain to save all sentient beings.

Seeing his old friend whom he had not seen for many years, Master Qinggang quickly gave up his secret rivalry with Yefeng. He changed his bad attitude of being cold and unwilling to see anyone, and called Penglai very cordially.

"Xiao, Peng, Lai."

Penglai calmly shook off the goosebumps all over his body and saluted him in a formal manner.

"I've met Master Qinggang," said the old man, saying not to call him that kind of name. You have a bad memory as you get older, right?

"How is your senior brother doing lately?"

"Back to the real person, Senior Brother is still in seclusion."

"Why, that kid still wants to become a monk all the time?" It didn't take long for Master Qinggang to show his true self that he didn't deserve a beating. "Speaking of it, your Golden Sect is interesting enough. The disciples under your sect are either greedy for money or power-loving. Not only are there thieves, but they are also afraid of chaos in the world. How come you have such a weirdo who wants to escape into Buddhism every day?"

"..." Can you give him two swords?

"Ahem." Yefeng was grinding his teeth secretly in Penglai, but he did not forget to remind him that she still exists here.

"I've met the palace master." Penglai, whose status was inferior to others, bent down again.

She is also the one who makes people want to grab a kitchen knife as soon as she opens her mouth. "Brother Penglai, although I said that our debts have been paid in full, the interest owed by the Golden Gate and the compensation for damage to the buildings in my palace can you be tighter and send someone to pay it back as soon as possible.""..." Can you give her three swords?

Woo hoo, senior brother, someone is bullying me...

As if he had already seen the angry flames behind Penglai, Ye Ci, who was quite sympathetic to him, couldn't help but turn around and couldn't bear to see the two guys who loved to talk and hurt others abuse him.

"How far has your martial arts progressed recently?" Master Qinggang raised a topic just in time when the expression on his face was getting more and more impatient and he was about to throw up his face and leave at the next moment.

Unexpectedly, Penglai misunderstood and thought that Master Qinggang disliked his strength.

"If the real person thinks that I am not qualified to stand here, you can find someone who can take my place." He didn't want to come either, but the senior brother named him, how could he push him out?

Master Qinggang knew where Penglai's strength lay even without looking, but seeing him speaking so confidently, he couldn't help but count on his fingers, and then he pulled on his thin shield and smiled mockingly.

"It turns out to be the reincarnation of the God of Death."

As soon as the long-lost words entered Penglai's ears, Penglai's original black eyes immediately turned blood red. Seeing this, Ye Ci quickly pulled Ye Feng into his arms and stepped back a few steps. Only Qinggang Zhenren, who was exposing others' secrets, could not suppress Penglai and saw the inner energy constantly bursting out of his body.

Facing the murderous aura, Ye Feng hid in Ye Ci's arms and reminded Penglai.

"Contain your murderous intent. I didn't come all the way here to fight." If he was so excited and exploded with just one sentence, how could his senior brother feel free to let him go?

Penglai suppressed the thirsty killing intent in his eyes, clenched his fists, and tried to calm his heartbeat and breathing. When Yefeng rolled his eyes at him, Qinggang Zhenren, who was watching from the side, reluctantly shot a yellow talisman from his sleeve and stuck it on Penglai's body. The murderous aura that filled the hall disappeared completely.

Yefeng didn't have any patience to talk to them about family matters at this time. She was ready to fight and leave quickly. When the atmosphere in the hall was almost calm, she opened her mouth and pointed to the center of gravity.

"What are your plans for the Soul Reading Record?" She came here today to resolve the mess that happened thirteen years ago and take responsibility. "Since the Soul Reading Record was leaked from my palace, I have the responsibility to take it back to prevent it from harming the world in the future. Even if I can't take it back, I will."Destroy it." Since Xuan Ling failed in his pursuit of Yi Chen, this time, with the help of his senior brother, the Golden Gate spies found out a lot of secrets about the Soul Reading Record. The reason why senior brother sent him here is because the seriousness of this matter is not something that only the three of them can afford.

"The soul paper causing trouble to the world can only be considered a small matter. The important thing is that we cannot let the culprit from hundreds of years ago resurrect."

"The culprit?" Yefeng raised his eyebrows in confusion, but Master Qinggang, who didn't say anything, silently took a cup of tea.

"My junior brother Xuan Ling recently found out that although the two soul servants promised by Situ Shuang are serving Situ Shuang, they may have other masters in the world to serve, and these soul servants have the ability to make the soul master into a puppet to protect the soul master from death and not be controlled by the soul master." Yefeng's face turned pale at the moment. Soul servants who can break away from the constraints of the soul contract and are not controlled by the soul master?

Isn’t the world still in chaos?

"Real person?" Penglai looked at Qinggang, who had lived the longest and knew the most about the world, asking for advice.

Master Qinggang put down the tea cup in his hand and thought for a long time before he spoke.

"Do you know where the Soul Reading Record came from? And who made it?"

They both bowed their heads, "I don't know."

Who knows who made that thing?They weren't even born yet, okay?

"I only know that the person who made the soul paper used his children as the materials for the first batch of soul paper. Before he passed away, he probably asked his descendants to make soul paper for him, so that he can be reincarnated for all generations."

"What!"

"So if you have time to wait in Dao'er, you might as well go down the mountain and find the paper maker who promised to be reincarnated hundreds of years ago. Otherwise, what we will face next time will not be a soul disaster, but a soul disaster."

"By combining the power of the three parties like us and uniting the other countries, are we still afraid that we can't do anything to them?" Penglai frowned, finding it difficult to accept that kind of future.

Master Qinggang held his cheek with one hand and smiled at him with an incomprehensible smile.

"What if I say it's a bit difficult?"

【Complete book】

On New Year's Eve, An Ye and Xianxian and I celebrated the New Year online.

While we were waiting for the time, the three of us were bored and chatted about making wishes during the New Year. Then, while chatting, we started walking farther and farther away from the building until... Mouhen: "If the end of the world comes, what are you going to stock up on?" Mouxin: "Weapons."

Patient: "Food."

Mouhen: "Do you think someone wants to hoard toilet paper?"

A certain immortal: "..."

A patient: "..."

Mouhen: "I have read a lot of novels about the end of the world. When the heroes and heroines in them learned that the end of the world was coming, they all hoarded food, piled clothes, and weapons like arms dealers. But in my eyes, they were just a bunch of heroes and heroines who couldn't fight." There was silence in the chat room for a long time.
